decisionRule: ACCEPT only if there are zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX findings. One SHOULD-FIX survived refutation, therefore REJECT.
discipline: Independent. Refute, do not confirm. The subject was tested against all thirty-one recorded inputs, frozen g20-leftover-join.v4, frozen G20 occupancy v2, frozen sdk-leftover-join.v6, live D-268 and file-08 state, the D-086/D-145/D-184/D-195/D-217/D-264/D-267/D-268 lineage, both v4 reviews, both sdk-v6 reviews, the complete v4-to-v5 semantic delta, catalog/input-corpus parity, the exact six-obligation partition, cross-ledger non-theft, every current-versus-historical qualifier, and all no-SATISFIED/no-fixture/no-SDK-API/no-occupancy/no-implementation boundaries. The current Claude review of this v5 subject was not opened, read, or used.
summary: REJECT at 0 blockers, 0 MUST-FIX, and 1 SHOULD-FIX. V5 otherwise correctly advances the G20 successor speaker to v5; pins v4 at D-264; keeps v4 current at draft time and historical only after successor recording; keeps occupancy v2 current; preserves leftoverDesign [OBL-G20-FX-AUTHORING]; retains OBL-SDK-API-RESERVED and OBL-DR125-ACTIVATION on their owning rows; pins sdk-leftover-join.v6 / D-267 as current; preserves required-now 28; and crosses no application, fixture, API, qualification, occupancy, or implementation boundary. But basedOn.sdkJoinV4.role was copied byte-for-byte from v4 and still says the current DR-125 join is sdk-leftover-join.v5 / D-184. D-267 replaced that join with sdk-leftover-join.v6, which every other operative v5 recital correctly recognizes. The isolated stale current-standing sentence must be repaired before acceptance.

findings.title: A copied historical role still calls sdk-leftover-join.v5 current after D-267
findings.charge: The v5 subject's basedOn.sdkJoinV4.role says 'Current DR-125 ROW leftover-join is sdk leftover-join.v5 (D-184).' That sentence was true in frozen g20-leftover-join.v4 at its D-263 dispatch, but D-267 subsequently recorded sdk-leftover-join.v6 as the current DR-125 leftover-join. V5 copied the entire sdkJoinV4 role byte-for-byte while correctly advancing the current SDK join everywhere else, leaving two contradictory current standings in one artifact.
evidence: The exact sdkJoinV4.role string is byte-identical between frozen g20-leftover-join.v4 and this v5 subject.
D-267 at commit 1e3e6644edf88fd9a0f11affb1addb70c71393f6 records sdk-leftover-join.v6 as the current DR-125 leftover-join; live COORD and the prompt both require that standing.
The frozen sdk-leftover-join.v6 artifact is pinned at e91d6e926830833d563bb89f3693d65328173af6f0d42275ad5339ef73880341 and was independently accepted 0/0 by both reviewers before D-267 recording.

V5's registerRowNote, purpose, basedOn.sdkJoinV5.role, basedOn.d267.role, basedOn.sdkJoinV6.role, remeasurementClause, OBL-SDK-API-NOT-STOLEN reason, and doesNot list all correctly make sdk v6 current and sdk v5 historical or non-current.
A complete recursive string scan finds the stale unqualified current-v5 sentence at exactly one path: basedOn.sdkJoinV4.role.
findings.historicalReadingConsidered: The surrounding role begins with historical facts about sdk-leftover-join.v4 at HEAD 5d5d778 / required-now 26. That does not turn the bare present-tense sentence 'Current ... is sdk leftover-join.v5' into a historical quotation. The same role separately says 'Not current' for sdk v4 and ends with present lineage guidance; unlike predecessorV4.role, it does not say that another artifact merely cited v5 as current. The prompt expressly attacks any citation of sdk v5 as the current DR-125 join.
findings.whyShouldFix: This is a false current-standing recital in pinned lineage metadata and directly contradicts the v5 artifact's operative current-state claims. It should not enter a frozen successor or later coordinator record unresolved.
findings.whyNotMustFix: The defect is isolated to one nested predecessor-role sentence. The top-level purpose, register note, explicit sdkJoinV5 and sdkJoinV6 roles, D-267 custody, obligation ledger, remainder set, and every authority boundary use the correct v6 standing. No digest, closure bit, ownership, SATISFIED state, or implementation authority is corrupted.
findings.repair: In a frozen successor, rewrite basedOn.sdkJoinV4.role so its D-184 statement is explicitly historical and its present-current sentence names sdk-leftover-join.v6 / D-267, or remove the redundant present-current sentence and rely on sdkJoinV5/sdkJoinV6. Preserve the frozen v4 subject unchanged.
